subject: Science
chapter_title: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body

content.overview: Canonical source-derived learning unit: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body.
source_grounded_key_points: One who eats food that is wholesome, in moderate quantities, and appropriate for the season, time, and place.
(Wise saying) Medu and Mishti read ‘thought of the day’ on अन्‍नेन जातानि जीवन्‍त‍ि the school noticeboard annena jātāni jivanti every day.
Today’s thought, ‘annena jātāni jivanti’, makes them curious.
Mishti tells Medu that it is a Sanskrit saying which means ‘food gives life to living beings.’ Let us try to understand the significance of this saying.
Activity 3.1: Let us record All of us eat food every day.
List the food items you have consumed over the week in Table 3.1.
Do you eat the same kind of food in every meal or do your choices vary?
Find similarities and differences in the food consumed by you and your friends.
